question: Which option best reflects the evolved focus of India–US Exercise Tiger Triumph 2025 compared to 2019?

options.text: HADR with logistics cooperation under LEMOA

solution:
The correct answer is __**HADR with logistics cooperation under LEMOA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Exercise Tiger Triumph is a bilateral India-US military exercise that began in 2019, focusing on tri-service cooperation in humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) scenarios.
 
• For the 2025 iteration, the exercise is expected to incorporate logistics cooperation under the Logistics Exchange Memorandum of Agreement (LEMOA), which facilitates the use of each other’s bases for logistics support, enhancing operational readiness.
 
• The inclusion of logistics under LEMOA reflects a deepening of strategic ties and interoperability between India and the US armed forces.
 
• HADR operations remain the central focus of the exercise, aiming to improve joint response capabilities during natural disasters and humanitarian crises in the Indo-Pacific region.
 
• This evolution aligns with the broader strategic goals of the two nations in ensuring regional stability and addressing non-traditional security challenges effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shift to space warfare**

 
 
• Space warfare involves military operations in outer space, including the use of satellites and other space-based assets for offensive and defensive purposes.
 
• Although space cooperation is a growing area of interest in India-US ties, it is not the focus of Exercise Tiger Triumph, which emphasizes HADR and tri-service collaboration.
 
 
 
• **Focus only on cyber drills**
 
 
• Cyber drills are exercises designed to test and enhance cybersecurity capabilities, focusing on protecting critical infrastructure and responding to cyber threats.
 
• While cyber security is a critical domain in India-US defense cooperation, it is not the sole focus of Exercise Tiger Triumph, which primarily centers on HADR.
 
 
 
• **Removal of tri-service nature**
 
 
• Tri-service exercises involve the participation of all three branches of the armed forces—Army, Navy, and Air Force.
 
• Exercise Tiger Triumph was conceptualized as a tri-service exercise, and its unique nature lies in this collaboration. Removing the tri-service format would fundamentally alter the purpose of the exercise, which is not the case in its evolution towards 2025.
